summary: MindWalk Holdings Corp. (NASDAQ: HYFT), a British Columbia-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 14, 2026 press release confirming a binding commitment with Sanabil (Cayman) for a senior unsecured revolving credit facility of up to US$30 million, at a fixed 7.00% annual rate accruing only on drawn amounts, 36-month initial term extendable 12 months, 1.00% one-time opening fee, no unused-line fee, no financial covenants, warrants, equity conversion, or asset pledge. Target closing within 60 days; no obligation to borrow, penalty-free repayment. This is routine credit-facility financing, not a special situation. Watch definitive agreement execution and any drawdowns.
